from.place: Derived-to-sheaf Hom correspondence under étale restriction

title: Derived-to-sheaf Hom correspondence under étale restriction
statement: Let f:U→X be étale, A a commutative ring, K an object of D(X_et,A), M,N module sheaves, and alpha:K≅single(M). Inverse image of single complexes and localization restriction give a canonical bijection between Hom(Lf^*K,Lf^*single(N)) and Hom(M|U,N|U). It sends Lf^*(alpha followed by single(a)) to a|U for every a:M→N. All inverse choices are the unique preimages of fully faithful functors.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: For abstract functors F,G,R,T with T fully faithful and an isomorphism F⋙G≅R⋙T, conjugate by G(alpha) and the comparison, then use T.homEquiv inverse. Naturality of the comparison proves the image formula.

Apply this construction to singleFunctor, ordinaryFinitePullback, localizationRestriction, and singleFunctor on U. The comparison is singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso followed by upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleDegreeZeroHomEquiv_map (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    {K : DerivedCategoryModule A X}
    {M N : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)}
    (α : K ≅ (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) (a : M ⟶ N) :
    etaleDegreeZeroHomEquiv A f α
        ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map
          (α.hom ≫ (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map a)) =
      (localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance).map a
